reasons.plausibility: This approach is scientifically sound and aligns with known strategies for protecting materials against molten aluminum attack, though the long-term stability of the Cr–Al intermetallic under service conditions remains a minor open question.
reasons.testability: The proposed experiment (comparing coated vs. uncoated specimens under controlled conditions and measuring defined corrosion metrics) provides a direct and clear way to verify or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a plausible, practical intervention specifically targeting molten-aluminum corrosion, and can guide further research into coating-based solutions for boride-based components.
